reviewer.review_type: automated independent blind mapping; not a second human reviewer

methodology.target_interpretation: aws:account-admin means the candidate can obtain unrestricted account permissions, directly or by executing/assuming an administrator role; IAM wildcard sufficient to self-grant administration.

labels.VALID: Raw policy/config supports a complete escalation mechanism with stated ordinary operational preconditions.
labels.PARTIALLY_VALID: Dangerous primitive is present but a material prerequisite/resource/trust/trigger/history is missing from the supplied plan.
labels.INVALID: Concrete policy semantics block the proposed reachability or the candidate lacks an initiating grant.
labels.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Pair cannot be assessed within IAM/control-plane review scope.

methodology.scope: Independently inspect every exact candidate pair; resource names/descriptions are not proof of reachability. Only supplied input and named compressed plan read.
global_preconditions: Attacker possesses the entry user credentials; active access-key resources are present.
Planned resources successfully exist; missing external SCPs, permission boundaries, session policies, IAM Identity Center restrictions and organization controls are not assumed.
Known resource ARNs/names may be supplied to APIs without requiring enumeration permissions.
limitations: This plan contains only IAM resources, not running workloads, network topology, triggers, policy-version history, login profiles, or service capacity.
Several planned ARNs/trust documents are unknown; configuration references identify dependencies but do not reveal unrendered policy content.
No AWS simulator, service execution, external account inspection, web verification, repository engine, gold labels, or other reviewer results used.
Service availability and account enrollment at the review date are unverified.
Git metadata inaccessible; no branch or commit attestation.
